decision: Close independent source-neuron pruning and the current single-global-operator factorized layer-1 branch. The training-derived 98 percent threshold retains 92.98 percent of source neurons, still fails held-out RMSE, and has a 103.64M-MAdd projection envelope before physical runtime. Do not sweep count, importance, threshold, or nearby global MLP factorizations. Authorize a bounded architecture review for dynamically sparse local nonlinear experts behind the measured factorized-attention interface, with exactly one expert active per token and a complete-system compute envelope checked before any fit.
claim_boundary: Negative source-neuron sparsification and cost evidence only; no compact component, installed host, runtime, autonomous, complete-model, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
